plugin.name: xWeatherRouting
plugin.summary: Advanced weather routing with departure and arrival planning.
plugin.author: Sean d'Epagnier; Weather Routing Plugin Team
plugin.description: WeatherRouting offers Auto, Quick, Standard, Professional and All (slow), with independent saved engine settings and explicit search presets. Auto falls back through Quick and Standard to Professional up to 400% effort. All compares four engines, including the internal Alternative engine, and shares a bounded extra-search allowance across successful engines. Optional fastest/comfort alternatives also work with individual engines and Auto, with saved percentage and seconds limits. A retained-route comparison table and slider balance passage time against discomfort exposure while preserving the worst known leg. Wind-only ranking is enabled by default and remembered. Extra comfort limits never reduce the ordinary engines' budgets; All initially selects the earliest validated arrival. Quick uses hardened contour routing with independent chronological validation. Standard provides bounded adaptive search; Professional keeps a validated Quick candidate and searches for a faster route with broader recovery methods. All support plugin-managed GSHHG shorelines; optional chart-backed safety requires a compatible host.
